reconstruction.rebuild: Load this JSON as PitRoute and encode_route for pit_lane.bin. Compose protection with circuit escapes through circuit_route_assets.py; do not overwrite a combined protection file with the standalone pit-only encoding.

recipe_snapshot.source_note: PRIVATE CANDIDATE. Real retained mapped pit route. Width, speed line positions and reconstructed floor remain pending primary source/native review. Road endpoint registration residual is absorbed over 25m. No surveyed floor or final acceptance claim. Superseded constant4m width by the bounded variable-width profile in pit-fast-lane-width.json.

plan_registration.imagery_epoch: Unknown; provider acquisition and watermark do not establish capture year.

protection_snapshot.source_note: Retained barrier geometry plus primary Google pit/road/garage relationship. New divider lies between unchanged Road+0.85m kerb and actual mapped pit paving; XY is estimated within this visible strip. Existing 0.95m concrete collision height and 0.15m radius retained. Native/source review required, especially joins to retained wall ends.

reconstruction.validation_limits: Sampled runtime PASS does not establish full driving, native mesh clearance, geometry fidelity or visual approval. Reconstructed ramp heights and divider positions retain their stated uncertainty.

working_support.support_frame: Literal PitSection.normal points source-right. Negative extent supplies left garage apron.
working_support.floor: Exact pit z + cross_slope*lateral plane; no DSM/Road height replacement.
working_support.source_note: Video613–624s working lane/parallel stop; plan widths estimated. Spatial garage binding uses local Road segments within50m metadata window. Pit track_station is progress metadata, not a perpendicular physical cross-section.

pit_exit_source_variant.decision: Open-sky supplied-reference variant; preserve literal branch andretainwestservicebody, finiteeasterntiptermination. Google unknown-epoch covering/OSMtunnel conflict disclosed.

fast_lane_revision.plan: Keep the personnel-side driving edge and existing divider fixed. Move the fast-lane centre0.5m towards the garages and its garage-side edge1m into the ample working apron. Preserve garage fronts, stop boxes and all protection coordinates.
fast_lane_revision.source_limit: Footage establishes separate garage working area, fast lane and personnel platform, but does not meter-verify width. Five metres is a revised driving/view reconstruction estimate in response to the compressed prior4m model, not an FIA dimension.
fast_lane_revision.progress: Preserve original mapped progress metadata and limiter controls; recomputed planar path length differs slightly after the local axis shift.
